Between systems and people

Computer Science and Statistics taught me to look closely at systems, recognize patterns, and approach problems carefully. But some of the most meaningful parts of my university experience happened through conversations, collaboration, and community.

My practice lives in that overlap: structured enough to make things work, curious enough to make them feel alive. Whether I am designing a workflow, a poster, a short film, or a sentence, I am interested in clarity, attention, and human experience.

I’m still learning every instrument in the orchestra of making.
